predictions.articleTitle: Fujieda MYFC vs Ventforet Kofu Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Kofu's Road Fragility
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Fujieda MYFC Win or Draw (Home Win / Draw) anchored on an Under 2.5 goal expectancy profile against Kofu's injury-hit defense.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Fujieda's 75% home unbeaten rate and Kofu's zero-clean-sheet away defense support a home victory while Fujieda's 50% home draw rate keeps the stalemate covered (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 — Supported by a 51.4% Poisson Under 2.5 baseline and both sides averaging under 0.68 decayed goals over the past five rounds (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle: 1:1 Transition Draw — If Fujieda struggle to create without injured Yusuke Kikui, Yamato Naito can replicate Kofu's recent 1:1 road draws (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Fujieda's home resilience tests Kofu's zero-clean-sheet, injury-depleted road defense.

spf.comment: Covers a 2:0 home win against Kofu's depleted, zero-clean-sheet defense and a 1:1 draw driven by Fujieda's 50% home draw rate and five-match winless slump, since a single home call carries unnecessary stalemate risk.

over_under.comment: Independent Poisson Under 2.5 probability (51.4%) aligns with both teams' sub-0.68 decayed five-match scoring rates and Yusuke Kikui's absence.

score.comment: 2:0 mirrors Fujieda's two-goal home wins and Kofu's multi-goal away defeats, while 1:1 is the top Poisson baseline scoreline.

goals.comment: 2 goals (25.0% Poisson probability) bridges both 2:0 and 1:1, with 1 goal covering a tight 1:0 home grind.

bqc.comment: Win-Win targets Kofu's 75% away half-time deficit rate, while Draw-Draw reflects Fujieda's 62.5% home half-time draw frequency.
